verdict.rationale: Abacum documents a built-in AI Modeler that builds financial models from plain-language instructions and an in-model AI that answers questions grounded in the business's data, so users can hand some modeling and analysis work to an embedded assistant. The evidence is two short marketing lines, however, and does not show how broad or autonomous that delegation is. Missing for 10: detailed docs on which tasks the assistant can perform and how, evidence of multi-step or agentic task execution beyond modeling and Q&A, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
